naming_rule.rule: Figma variable = the token path after the WordPress prefix, slash-separated, slugs verbatim. Every variable's WEB code syntax is the exact emitted CSS variable, which is the join key the parity script uses.

parity_checker.how: Dumps Figma variables through the MCP plugin API, joins on WEB code syntax, converts rem/em to px, alpha % to 0–1, fluid sizes to Mobile = min / Desktop = max, color-mix to flat hex, and checks the 5 effect styles.
parity_checker.pass_means: exit 0, zero unexplained deltas in both directions
parity_checker.cover_rule: Run the parity check — PASS required before designing.
